title: Improve subtitle readability, add Walter Russell quote, and add prominent NFT notice

requirements.text: Change the subtitle text styling to use light-colored text on a dark background for improved readability. Apply this change to the hero section subtitle where contrast is currently poor.

quotes: nur den Untertitel kann man nicht lesen, weil helle Schrift auf Hintergrund. Ich hätte gerne helle Schrift auf dunklem Hintergrund

acceptanceCriteria: Subtitle text uses light color (white or near-white)
Subtitle background is dark enough to provide strong contrast
Text remains readable across all screen sizes

requirements.text: Add a Walter Russell quote at the beginning of the website introduction section. The quote should be taken from the original website at https://lichtkunst.mydurable.com/ and displayed prominently before other introductory content.

quotes: Beginne die Einleitung auf die Website mit einem Zitat von Walter Russell, entnommen von der alten Website

acceptanceCriteria: Walter Russell quote is displayed at the start of the introduction section
Quote text matches content from the original lichtkunst.mydurable.com website
Quote is visually distinguished from regular text (e.g., larger font, different styling, quotation marks)
Quote appears before other introductory content

requirements.text: Add a prominent notice at the top of the website stating that all artworks are NFTs on the Internet Computer Protocol (ICP). This notice should be highly visible and appear before the main content to inform visitors immediately.

quotes: Es soll ein ausdrücklicher Hinweis einleiten, daß alle Kunstwerke NFTs auf der ICP sind

acceptanceCriteria: Notice clearly states that all artworks are NFTs on ICP
Notice is positioned prominently at or near the top of the page
Notice is visually distinct and immediately noticeable to visitors
Text is in German to match user's language preference

constraints: Do not modify Internet Identity authentication hooks (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts)
Do not modify Shadcn UI components in frontend/src/components/ui
Keep existing NFT minting backend logic intact
Preserve all existing artwork upload and gallery functionality
nonGoals: Implementing actual NFT minting functionality (separate complex task)
Adding ICP cost calculations or technical minting details to the UI
Modifying the backend NFT data model
Creating new pages or navigation structure
